insights: ✅ Mālama (care/stewardship) is strongly positive — use land-based activities to reinforce cultural connection

narrative.summary: The cohort mean for ʻIke Kūpuna is 69.5. 29.4% of students are Proficient or Advanced. 35 students require targeted cultural support. Hawaiian Language programme shows a +11.4 pt effect; Hālau Hula shows a +6.3 pt effect.
